purpose: Canonicalize internationalized mailbox domains to ASCII A-labels before SMTP MAIL FROM/RCPT TO and MIME address headers. The active client does not negotiate SMTPUTF8; non-ASCII local parts therefore fail closed. This is a transport-only correction for the PC-CROP reviewer password-reset path.
